## 服务端契约与元数据一致性

本次预览版强化了服务端并发与公开契约：人工匹配或替换元数据时，数据库会权威检查媒体库是否正在扫描，避免多实例部署下的晚到写入覆盖扫描结果；HTTP 与 SSE 受保护路由统一使用强类型认证提取器；API 文档、官网接口说明和服务端路由增加自动一致性校验。

运行配置现在会拒绝非法端口与 Worker 并发值，而不再静默回退。NFO 中已选择的演员信息继续优先于远端演员缓存，并新增数据库测试锁定该行为。

迁移 `0005` 会在启动时自动把剧集大纲缓存升级为数据库校验的 `jsonb`。迁移原地执行，无需重建数据库、重新扫描媒体库或重建缓存。

HTTP/HTTPS `.strm` 支持仍为实验功能，仅支持指向直接媒体资源的 HTTP/HTTPS 地址；暂不支持 RTSP、MMS、HLS/M3U8、自定义请求头或 Cookie，也不提供远程转码。如遇到问题，欢迎通过 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/RichesChiu/mova/issues) 或 [Telegram](https://t.me/mova_feedback) 反馈。

---

## Server contract and metadata consistency

This preview strengthens server concurrency and public contracts. Manual metadata matching and replacement now perform an authoritative database check for active library scans, preventing late writes from overwriting scan results in multi-instance deployments. Protected HTTP and SSE routes now use typed authentication extractors, while automated checks keep server routes, API documentation, and website API content synchronized.

Invalid port and worker-concurrency values now fail fast instead of silently falling back. Selected NFO cast data continues to take precedence over provider cast cache, with database coverage locking in that behavior.

Migration `0005` automatically upgrades the episode outline cache to database-validated `jsonb` at startup. It runs in place and does not require a database rebuild, media-library rescan, or cache rebuild.

HTTP/HTTPS `.strm` support remains experimental and is limited to direct HTTP/HTTPS media resources. RTSP, MMS, HLS/M3U8, custom request headers or cookies, and remote transcoding are not supported. Please report problems through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/RichesChiu/mova/issues) or [Telegram](https://t.me/mova_feedback).
